intro.text: Winds, an Eelakin working for the Northern Interests Trading Company at its fortress on Patji.

items.text: Winds sailed with the company expedition to Patji and stayed at the fortress it built while Vathi went scouting for a second site. There he and others opened one of the machines the Eelakin had received from the Ones Above, hoping to work out how it functioned.
When Vathi and Dusk reached the fortress after their night crossing, Vathi told him to shut the machine off. Winds insisted it had never been switched on; they had only opened it up.
